resources.string: Patch stopped answering. Tap Try again.
Patch is taking too long to start. Tap Try again, or close Patch and open it again.
There\'s no app on this phone that can open that.
There\'s no app on this phone for choosing files.

Lets Patch see what\'s on your screen and tap, scroll and type for you when you ask, for example to choose a search result in your browser, pick a song in Spotify or send music to a speaker. Patch never reads or types passwords, and asks you before tapping anything that buys, sends or deletes something.
Keep talking to Patch while you use other apps.
